title: Host discussed precognition hypothesis with Hal Puthoff

tellings.quote: I spoke to how put off who ran the Stargate the psychic fire program for the CIA

plain: Michels says that he talked about the idea of precognition, seeing the future, with Hal Puthoff, whom he describes as the man who ran Stargate, the CIA's program on psychic spying. He brings it up in a conversation with Eric Wargo, an author who writes about prophetic dreams, to show the idea is taken up by people who did such work for the government.
